name: 千里无踪的过客巴耶力
who: Bayeli, seen on its throne as a single standing cloak of faded grey feathers, a little taller than three people in the frame. The hood is empty and dark, the sleeves are empty, there is no face, no hands and no body inside, and the hem never touches the ground. It stands alone in the middle of a bare circle of packed earth with nothing else in the circle. The wind is drawn as long white streaks that always bend and part around it, leaving a still hollow where it stands. Cold, silent, unreachable.
palette: faded ash grey, feather white, firelight orange at the edges
formal: It stands upright on its high seat, a bare windswept plateau: an empty circle of packed earth with a ring of small campfires far out on the horizon, the grey feather cloak hanging in the centre of the circle with a dark empty hood and empty sleeves and nothing inside it, the hem hanging just clear of the ground, white wind-lines bending away from it on every side.
art: Seen from far below, from the kneeling ring of firelight looking up: the feather cloak cold grey against a wind-scoured twilight sky, light from low firelight below the left edge, the hood a hole of black, torn feathers drifting in the foreground.

name: 久夜之骑塞列欧斯
who: Seleos, a rider wrapped in a long cloak the colour of night, mounted on a huge black crocodile longer than a river bend, drawn as one figure. The hood is black inside and shows no face. Black river mud drips from the crocodile's back and claws. The cloak is wrapped tight and the whole figure moves slowly, as if time clings to it. Above its head the clouds have closed into one solid sheet with only a thin slit of lead grey to the east.
palette: mud black, deep indigo, a thin line of lead grey
formal: It sits motionless in the saddle on its throne, a half-sunk slab of black stone in the mud of a river mouth, the black crocodile crouched on the slab beneath it with mud dripping from its claws; the rider's hood is dark and empty of any face, the clouds overhead closed over it, and only one thin slit of lead-grey sky shows far to the east.
art: From the mud flat below, looking up at the rider: a black silhouette against a sealed cloud ceiling, a thin lead-grey light from the east edge, mud and reeds blurred in the foreground.

name: 黑鬃之首锡蒙力
who: Simoli, a rider and a huge black-maned beast grown together so that nobody can tell where the rider ends and the beast begins, drawn as one figure. The mane streams behind it like black smoke and pulls out into a whole host of black riders that follow it. The mane covers the head and no face shows. The hooves raise no dust. Colours are black and iron grey, with the mane tips touched by a cold silver.
palette: black, iron grey, cold silver mane tips
formal: It stands on its throne, the flat top of a black sheer-sided mountain, the rider-beast reared up with its mane covering the head and trailing back as smoke that turns into a long column of black riders far behind it, the hooves touching the rock without raising any dust.
art: From the foot of the black mountain looking steeply up: the mane drawn as black smoke edged with cold silver, a pale light from the upper right on the smoke edges, dark rock and a few riders blurred in front.

name: 迷群的牧笛卡伊姆
who: Kaimu, a very tall, gaunt piper, nearly three metres standing and thin as a post, wrapped in a flock of birds that circle him against the wind. The face is hidden behind a mask made from a bird skull, and the pipe is a length of bone. A long drab cloak of slate grey hangs in a fitted cut with a hood and buttons down the front. The birds' feather tips are a sickly yellow. A patient, thin, unhurried stillness.
palette: slate grey, raven black, feather tips of sickly yellow
formal: He sits upright on a throne of black stone cut into the top of a black sea-cliff, the bird-skull mask turned toward the viewer, the bone pipe held at his chin, a ring of birds wheeling around the throne in the opposite direction to the wind, the grey sea far below.
art: From the foot of the cliff looking up: the bird-skull mask against a pale slate sky, light from the upper left, a flurry of dark birds blurred in front.

name: 无岸之帆西珥
who: Sill, a great sail standing up in the sky, billowing full of wind. Behind the sail is a mast, and at the masthead stands a tall humanoid figure with one palm held open and empty. Its face is smooth like the carved figurehead of a war-ship, every feature worn away to nothing. The sailcloth is grey-white, damp, and crusted with salt along its edges. Sea grey, salt white and deep teal.
palette: sea grey, salt white, deep teal
formal: It stands at the masthead of a great sail that fills with wind above a reef island, the figure's open empty palm held forward, the worn smooth figurehead face turned down; below, black water and the rocks of the island with a few ships labouring toward it without reaching it.
art: From the deck of a labouring boat looking up: the huge salt-crusted sail glowing grey-white, a cold sea-light from the right, spray and rope blurred in the foreground.

name: 不愈之镞勒莱耶
who: Leleye, a giant archer made of layers upon layers of deep-brown shadows, each layer drawing its own bowstring. Two thin horns sweep back from the brow. The bow is longer than a ridge of hills, its limbs black, and the arrowhead glows with the pus-green of a wound that does not close. The face is smeared into a blur inside the layered shadows. Rock black, shadow brown, a sickly green.
palette: rock black, shadow brown, pus green
formal: It sits drawn on its throne, a slab of black rock jutting from the middle of a long ridge, the layered shadow body bent to the bow with every layer drawing, the pus-green arrowhead aimed straight down at the viewer, a long straight river lying at the foot of the ridge like a bowstring.
art: From below, as if the kneeling viewer is the target: the green arrowhead the only bright point, a sickly green light from the centre, the shadow body dark brown behind it.

name: 雪线外的白骑弗尔卡斯
who: Furkas, a very old white-bearded man on a tall white horse, wrapped in a thick white cloak caked with snow that never melts. The place behind him on the horse is empty and his own back is empty. His face is half in shadow under a white hood. Horse and rider are drawn as one figure, the horse standing quite still, its breath not showing. White, snow grey and pale steel.
palette: white, snow grey, pale steel
formal: He sits the white horse in front of his throne, a white mountain above the snow line, the horse standing in deep snow, the empty saddle space behind the rider turned toward the viewer, the white mountain top rising above them against the sky.
art: From the snow line below looking up: the old man's beard and the white hood against a pale sky, a cold steel-white light from the left, drifting snow blurred in front.

name: 不息之暴弗尔弗尔
who: Fulfur, a column of wind rolling from the ground up to the base of the clouds, carrying flat blades of stone and torn tents and banners in it, with a black eye at its centre and inside the eye a perfectly round black stone floating. There is no humanoid shape and no face. The column never stops turning. Earth grey, slate blue and the cold light of stone blades.
palette: earth grey, slate blue, cold blade light
formal: The column of wind stands over its throne, a perfectly round black stone worn smooth on a bare windswept plain of stone blades, the black eye of the wind hanging directly over the stone, shreds of tent cloth and flags spiralling up in the column.
art: From the ground at the foot of the column looking up into the eye: stone blades glittering with a cold edge-light, a flat grey-blue light from the left, flying grit blurred in front.

name: 悬息布涅
who: Bunie, a withered giant, close to three metres and very thin, half lying on a stone couch. A breath is stuck in his chest and never leaves it, and a small cloud of white mist hangs at his mouth without dissolving or falling. A thin burial veil covers his face and under it the mouth is puffed with the held breath, so no face shows. Wax-pale skin, a plain long shroud-like gown with buttons down the front and fitted sleeves.
palette: wax white, ash grey, clay brown
formal: He lies half upright on a long stone couch that is his throne, set in front of the mouth of a cave cut into a clay plateau, rows of still sleepers lying in the cave mouths behind and below, the white mist hanging at the veil and the flame of a single lamp beside him standing stuck at half height.
art: From the cave floor looking up past the stone couch: the veiled face and the held white mist, a dim lamp-light from the right, rows of still bodies blurred in front.

name: 铁笼与长索之主阿加雷斯
who: Agares, a colossal jailer, broad and heavy, about three metres tall. Its chest is an iron cage packed with shadowy human figures. Long iron chains and hook-lines hang from the cage and trail across the ground. The face is hidden behind an iron-barred helmet. It wears heavy iron plate, fitted at the arms. Iron grey, rope brown and rust.
palette: iron grey, rope brown, rust
formal: He sits straight and heavy on a throne of piled black stone in a black stone hall whose roads all circle back to its door, the chest-cage facing the viewer, chains laid across the steps and running out into the dark, the barred helmet looking straight ahead.
art: From the foot of the steps looking up: the barred helmet and the cage of shadows, a cold light from above left, chain links blurred in front.

name: 铸枷者葛摩恩
who: Gemoen, a vast broad figure whose face is a smooth plate of bare bronze with no eyes and no mouth, and whose horns curl inward like a yoke clamped on the head. The skin is a dull red-gold copper. Chains wrap its body in many coils and run down into the ground. Its five fingers are five pairs of tongs. Heavy, slow, unhurried, and it never comes out for the first two bells.
palette: bronze red-gold, chain iron, pit dark
formal: He rises half out of his throne, a deep well at the bottom of the deepest mine pit, the bronze-faced head and one shoulder above the rim, the five-tonged hand laid flat on the stone edge, chains from his body running into the ground, and tiny miners far below each with a ring of bronze round one foot.
art: From the bottom of the pit looking up the shaft: the bronze face against the circle of sky, a hot copper light from the right, chain links blurred in the foreground.

name: 拆墙者拜恩
who: Bayn in his later state: a stone giant with grey-brown skin like cut rock, drawn as a huge broad seated man. The left horn is broken off at the stump (on the viewer's left), the right eye is blind (on the viewer's right), a bronze spike is driven into one knee, a ring of fire burns in the chest and black light seeps from a wound on the left shoulder. The two horns are thick, short, blunt and ridged like broken stone. Wrapped in a haze of dust, hands like boulders.
palette: ash grey, dust yellow, black light, chest-fire orange
formal: He sits on a throne of stacked wall stones at the northern edge of a dead land, a half-built wall behind him crumbling, dust haze wrapping his lower body, the fire in his chest shining through, the hands like boulders resting on the stone arms of the seat.
art: From the ground below looking up: the broken horn and the blind eye, a red fire-glow from the chest lighting the stone skin, dust blurred in front.

name: 万物的点金手比利士
who: Bilis, a tall figure in a heavy gold robe, close to three metres, one hand of pure gold whose fingertips turn whatever they touch to gold. A gold mask covers the face with the mouth open, a breath frozen at its edge, so no real face is shown. Behind it stand row upon row of golden men and horses still caught in a charge. Fitted gold-embroidered doublet and long heavy surcoat.
palette: gold, dark bronze, river-valley grey
formal: He sits on a throne of dark ore on the top of a plateau, ringed by golden men and golden horses frozen in mid-charge, the gold hand resting on his knee with one finger lightly touching the throne arm and already turning it gold.
art: From the plain looking up past the golden ranks: the gold mask and the open frozen mouth, a hard warm light from the left, gold dust blurred in the foreground.

name: 碎骨之重哈根地
who: Hagendi, a stooped giant porter, very broad, with a black rock wider than himself pressed on his back, both hands braced on his knees, bone showing white through the cracks of split skin. The face is buried in the shadow of the black stone. A coarse hide jerkin and heavy belt, bare scarred forearms. Basalt black, bone white and dust grey.
palette: basalt black, bone white, dust grey
formal: He sits hunched on a throne cut from the flat top of a sheer-sided black mountain, the huge black stone still on his back, both hands braced on his knees, the mountain visibly worn smaller beneath him.
art: From the bottom of the mountain looking up: the great stone silhouette against the sky, a dim light from the upper right, bone-white cracks catching the light, dust blurred in front.

name: 错岸的断桥克罗塞尔
who: Croselle, a giant standing waist-deep in cold water, the bowed back forming a stone arch that is broken at the waist so that the two halves are offset by half a body width and do not meet. Cold water drips from the body and mist coils round the waist. The face is not shown. Wet black stone skin, a plain stone-grey cloak hung from the shoulders.
palette: wet black stone, cold river green, mist grey
formal: He stands in the river on his throne, a black stone platform in mid-stream, a half-built bridge head on each bank that does not reach the other, the two halves of the arched back offset above the water.
art: From the river surface looking up: the broken arch against a dull sky, a cold green light from the water, mist and spray blurred in front.

name: 百城之烬艾尼
who: Eni, a walking furnace. The body is a furnace of charred beams and city bricks, the chest opens as a furnace door with white fire inside. The head is a smoke vent trailing white flame, with no face. Ash falls from it all the time. A square-shouldered, heavy upright shape. White flame, ember red and charcoal black.
palette: white flame, ember red, charcoal black
formal: It stands upright on its throne, a flat-topped black mountain with a fire-vein beneath, the furnace door in its chest open toward the viewer so the white fire shows, the smoke vent head trailing white flame, ash drifting down the steps.
art: From below, kneeling in the falling ash: the white fire lighting the underside of the furnace body, a white light from the chest, glowing ash blurred in front.

name: 危塔之匠马尔法斯
who: Malfas, a tall thin craftsman, nearly three metres, with a great pair of night-dark wings folded behind and two unusually long hands. One hand holds a tower being built higher, the other rests on its top. A hood hides the face. A fitted dark-grey long coat with buttons down the front. Storm grey, night black and cloud white.
palette: storm grey, night wing black, cloud white
formal: He stands upon his throne, the flat top of the tallest stone pillar in a field of cliffs, one hand carrying a slender tower made of stacked cloud, the other pressed on its crown, the tower already beginning to lean.
art: From the pillar's foot looking up at the stormy sky: the hooded head and the small tower, a pale storm light from the upper left, torn cloud blurred in front.

name: 城门的裂隙概布
who: Gaibu, a colossal statue shaped like a doorframe with no door. Its chest is an empty gateway from which wind and ash pour, and bolts of gates slide open across its stone body. It has no face. Dark stone, tarnished bronze and ash grey. The stone is worn and old, and the bolts are bronze.
palette: dark stone, tarnished bronze, ash grey
formal: It stands as the doorframe in the centre of a black stone hall whose four walls are all open doorways without doors, wind and ash pouring out of the empty gateway toward the viewer, bronze bolts sliding open down its jambs.
art: From the threshold looking up through the doorframe: the empty gateway showing a dim grey beyond, light coming through it from behind, ash blurred in front.

name: 地下的盘蛇瓦拉克
who: Walak, a huge serpent coiled under the ground. The body never shows above the earth; there are only rings in the ground that swell and sink, and from a crack in the ground two cold points of light looking up. In the frame it is a coil of dark scaled body filling the crack, with two pale eyes. Dark earth and black.
palette: dark earth, black, two points of pale white
formal: The coils lie beneath a plateau throne whose edges crumble year by year, the surface rippling in rings above the buried body, and in the black crack at the centre two pale cold eyes looking straight up.
art: From the lip of the crack looking down into the dark: two points of pale white light and a hint of scaled coils, a faint light from the eyes, falling soil blurred in front.

name: 噬名者阿斯维尔
who: Aswier, a huge figure sitting wrapped in grey cloth, as tall as a belfry when seated. Faces rise to the surface of the cloth one after another and sink again, the faces of those whose names it has eaten. The face of the figure itself is smooth and flat with no features at all, and a long tongue lies out over the line of the mouth. A plain grey wrap fitted like a long coat.
palette: grey cloth, white fire, marsh black mud
formal: He sits on a smooth grey stone seat on an island of black mud in a marsh, the seat bare of any carved letter, a bowl of smokeless white fire before it, the faces drifting up through the grey cloth.
art: From the mud below the seat looking up: the flat blank face among the surfacing faces, a cold white light from the fire at lower left, marsh mist blurred in front.

name: 万卷的误译但他林
who: Dantalin, a tall thin figure whose long robe is stitched from pages written in reversed letters, the page corners stirring in the wind. In its hands a long scroll written backwards unrolls and hides the face completely. Fitted sleeves and a front of buttons under the pages. Parchment yellow-white and ink black.
palette: parchment yellow-white, ink black, salt-sea grey-teal
formal: He sits upright on a throne in a black stone hall whose walls are carved with letters, each legible but meaningless together, the reversed scroll held open before his face, a banner with a reversed-text scroll hanging behind.
art: From the floor of the hall looking up: the backwards-written scroll hiding the face, a warm parchment light from the left, flying pages blurred in front.

name: 凝固的晨昏贝利亚
who: Beria, a tall rein-holder gripping several golden reins whose far ends are drawn tight around a setting sun that has stopped. One half of the body is lit gold, the other half is black. The face is in backlight and unreadable. A fitted dark coat with a high collar and buttons. The shadow at its feet is very long and does not move.
palette: fixed dusk gold, long violet shadow, white sand
formal: He stands on his throne, a high plateau where all shadows point one way, the stopped sun fixed low at his side, the golden reins held taut in both fists, his long shadow lying motionless across the white sand.
art: From the sand looking up toward the stopped sun: half-gold half-black figure in backlight, a low gold light from the right, long violet shadows reaching the viewer.

name: 千舟之喉佛卡洛
who: Fokalo, a huge dark shape in the highest layer of the sky, with the dull bronze sheen of a war-ship figurehead. The sea beneath it is its open throat, rings of still water sinking downward. No face is shown, only a mouth. Deep teal-black, foam white and dull bronze. It looks like a presence rather than a body: huge, patient, silent, and hungry for ships.
palette: deep teal-black, foam white, dull bronze
formal: The dark bronze figure hangs over its throne, a flat black mountain at the sea's edge with a banquet hall half flooded by the tide, the sea below drawn as a round throat of still sinking water, ships drifting in toward it.
art: From a drifting boat looking up: the dark shape against a deep teal sky, a dull bronze glint from the upper left, foam blurred in the foreground.

name: 掩星斯托剌
who: Stora, a gigantic night owl whose wings span the whole sky. The wing membranes are freckled with hollow star-shaped frames and the beak is like a pair of shears. The eyes are dark and give no light. Deep blue and black with starlight silver. It sits quite still with its head turned slowly down, and the stars on its wings are all empty frames.
palette: deep blue, black, starlight silver
formal: It perches on the black flat top of its throne mountain, wings half spread over a sky of stars whose light does not reach the ground in front of the seat, the shear-like beak lowered toward the viewer.
art: From the dark ground looking up: the owl face edged with starlight silver, a faint silver light from above left, falling feathers blurred in front.

name: 坟烛与枯骨的主人比夫龙
who: Bifron, a tall thin lamp-bearer, close to three metres, with a long pole that carries a stone lamp whose light shines only downward onto the graves. A long robe the colour of old bone, fitted at the sleeves and buttoned down the front, with hands of bare bone. The hood is lit from beneath and shows only darkness.
palette: bone white, cold lamp white, black earth
formal: He stands on his throne at the heart of a vast field of graves, the lamp hung low on its pole, light falling only on the nearest grave mound, the hooded face dark.
art: From the grave ground looking up: the hood lit from beneath, a cold white lamp light from below, grave mounds blurred in front.

name: 闷雷之王安度西亚斯
who: Andresius, a vast storm cloud shaped like a colossal figure that holds a lightning whip raised over its head. The cloud is a heavy overturned dome and the figure has no face. Thunder rolls inside it and never falls. Storm grey, violet and blue-white. It never strikes; it only holds the stroke over the heads below, heavy, violet-edged and patient.
palette: storm grey, violet, blue-white
formal: The cloud-figure fills the sky above its throne, a high plateau under a permanent black ceiling, the lightning whip raised but never cracked.
art: From the plateau looking up: the dome of the cloud lit from inside, a violet light from the whip, wind-blown dust blurred in front.

name: 封冬亚斯她录
who: Astalu, an enormous figure frozen inside black ice, like a black mountain wrapped in an ice shell that has stood up to walk. The face is sealed in the ice and smeared. It breathes out no white breath, and anything near it frosts over. Black ice, deep blue and frost white. Its great shape is slow, stiff and silent, like a mountain that has decided to walk.
palette: black ice, deep blue, frost white
formal: It stands on its throne, a frozen black mountain at the edge of an ice sea whose summit ice has never melted, the ice-shell body facing the viewer, frost spreading on the ground around it.
art: From the ice looking up: the blurred sealed face in the black ice, a pale blue light from above left, frost crystals blurred in front.

name: 湿薪与冷灰亚米
who: Ami, a standing fire shaped roughly like a person and as tall as a belfry, its flame bright yellow-white while the ground all around it is cold wet grey ash. The firewood near it is black and wet and will not catch. It has no face. The fire lights only itself. It is bright but gives no warmth to anything but itself, and its edges flicker pale.
palette: bright yellow-white fire, cold grey ash, wet black
formal: The standing fire burns in a crack at the heart of a black plain where coal has smouldered underground for ages, the ash around it cold and damp, wood piled before it blackened and dripping and refusing to catch.
art: From the cold ash looking up: the bright fire lighting only itself, a hard yellow-white light with a dark rim around, wet black wood blurred in front.

name: 冒名之舌佛纽司
who: Funus, a tall slender figure of about two and a half metres draped in a long wine-red veil. Beneath the veil there are no features, only a single mouth with a thin long tongue. Rings of echo ripple out around her. A fitted wine-red gown with a high collar, fitted sleeves and buttons down the front. Wine red and rock-wall grey.
palette: wine red, rock-wall grey
formal: She sits upright on a black stone seat at the mouth of a deep four-walled gorge, echo rings spreading from her mouth across the floor of the gorge, the veil hanging straight.
art: From the gorge floor looking up: the veil and the single mouth, a dim red-grey light from the left, echo ripples blurred in front.

name: 先动的倒影瓦沙克
who: Washak, a tall narrow figure who stands as if upside down from beneath the surface of water and moves a beat before the person it mirrors. The face is the back of a mirror, dark silver, and reflects nothing. A fitted dark coat with buttons. Dark silver, black water and grey sky.
palette: dark silver, black water, grey sky
formal: He stands on his throne, a black stone cliff polished like a mirror, his reflection in the cliff face a beat ahead of him, a camp reflected on the polished rock below.
art: From below the cliff: the dark silver face reflecting nothing, a cold grey light from the left, black water blurred in front.

name: 倒读的先兆因波斯
who: Imbos, a tall seer wrapped in mist, wearing a mask upside down so that the eyes are below and the mouth above. In one hand a staff carved with omen marks. A fitted long coat of mist grey with buttons. Its shadow falls toward the light, not away from it.
palette: mist grey, night violet, stone grey-white
formal: He stands among a ring of standing stones on a high plateau, the staff planted, his shadow stretched toward the sun side, mist at his feet.
art: From among the stones looking up: the inverted mask in mist, a pale grey-violet light from the right, mist blurred in front.

name: 无归之形欧塞
who: Ose, a blank white mask with no features, below which the body keeps changing: wings, scales, webbed limbs, extra arms, then something else, while the mask never changes. Drawn as one figure from the chest up. The colours of the body shift like a beetle's shell. The shapes beneath the mask are never the same twice in one picture's worth of looking, and nothing about them is meant to belong together.
palette: tidal mud grey-brown, scale rainbow, mask white
formal: It rises from the centre of a black stone hall on a mud flat where trees grow downward and fish have legs, the white mask unchanging at the top of a body caught mid-change.
art: From the mud looking up: the white mask lit evenly, an iridescent scale light from the sides, mud blurred in front.

name: 饥渊者莫罗赫
who: Moroch, a gaunt grey-yellow skeleton giant, every rib an iron hoop around an enormous empty belly. It has no eyes and no nose; its only feature is one wide jaw hanging downward, the mouth gaping toward the ground. No flesh at all, dry and hollow, seated hunched with the great empty belly facing forward.
palette: grey-yellow bone, dry black, dust
formal: It sits hunched on a grey-yellow throne at the middle of a dark grain plain, the empty belly facing the viewer, the downward jaw open over the ground in front of the seat where rows of empty bowls are set.
art: From the ground among the empty bowls looking up: the hollow ribcage and the hanging jaw, a dry grey-yellow light from the left, dust blurred in front.

name: 撑裂的果实桀刚
who: Jigang, from afar a mountain, near at hand a forest that never stops growing: each branch pushes out of another and splits the first, and new growth breaks from every split. Black sap flows from the breaks. The mass is as high as a hill in the frame, with no face and no limbs, only branching trunk and swelling ground.
palette: new green, black sap, split-stone grey
formal: The growing forest-mountain occupies a stone dais that has been split three times by roots, new green branches bursting from the cracks, the ground swelling beneath it.
art: From the cracked dais looking up into the tangle: new green against black sap, a bright green light from the left, leaves blurred in front.

name: 未熟之腐马拉克斯
who: Malax, a huge seated humanoid, broad and heavy, in a thick dull dark-red cloak the colour of soured wine, with fitted sleeves and a buttoned dark-red doublet beneath. The face is hidden in shadow. Beside the throne stands a huge wine jar that goes sour before it can be opened. Fruit rots on the table before it ripens.
palette: soured wine brown-red, sour amber
formal: He sits at the head of a banquet table longer than a city wall that runs through a warm valley, the great jar at his side, food on the table half-rotten while only the blood in the cups stays fresh.
art: From the foot of the table looking up: the shadowed face above the soured red cloak, a sour amber light from the right, spoiled fruit blurred in front.

name: 自噬的狼群玛尔乔西亚斯
who: Marchosias, from afar one seated giant, close at hand a great crowd of beasts packed back to back and horn to horn into the outline of a person: wolves, boars, deer and birds, biting one another. A face-shaped hollow is formed from the heads of beasts. Pelt brown-grey with bone-white horns.
palette: pelt brown-grey, horn bone white, altar red
formal: It sits on the flat top of a black mountain in a plain of horns, a red stone altar at its feet with a bowl of blood, the beast-pack figure shifting all at once whenever one beast moves.
art: From the altar looking up: the face made from beast heads, a red-brown light from the left, bone-white horns blurred in front.

name: 易魂的火鸟菲尼克斯
who: Phoenix, a great bird of fire taller than a tower, whose head is a different bird's head every time it rises: it burns down to ash and rises again, and what rises is not the same one. Wings of flame, a body of red fire, ash falling from it. Each time it rises its colours change a little, and this time it is a deep red.
palette: red fire, ash grey, rebuilt black stone
formal: It stands on its throne, a black stone platform at a volcano mouth that burns down and rebuilds itself, wings spread in flame, ash falling beneath it.
art: From the molten plain below: the bird head in flame, a red fire light from the front, ash blurred in front.

name: 不结的花信单卡拉比
who: Dankarabi, a very tall woman of about two and a half metres whose whole figure is dressed in blossom. The face is covered by flowers. Not a single bee near her and no fruit anywhere. A fitted long gown made of overlapping flower petals, buttoned high at the neck, with fitted sleeves.
palette: blossom pink-white, sun gold, fruitless green
formal: She sits upright on a throne at the top of a sunny slope in constant bloom, flowers on every side of the seat and nothing ripening, no bee in the air.
art: From the flowers below: the face veiled in blossom, a bright warm light from the left, petals blurred in front.

name: 蚀心之盐佛拉斯
who: Phras, a huge broad humanoid in a hard shell of white salt, the shell cracked in places so that black shows within. The face is a smooth white shell with no features. It looks sound from outside and is rotten within. A fitted cuirass of salt crust and a long salt-stiff cloak.
palette: salt white, black seep, hollow grey
formal: He sits on a throne on a hard salt-crust plateau whose surface hides a hollow beneath, black seeping through the cracks of his shell and into the crust.
art: From the salt flat looking up: the blank shell face, a hard white light from above, salt crystals blurred in front.

name: 拒接的砧木巴拉姆
who: Balam, an enormous old anvil-block of dark wood with a single knot where a face would be. Grafted branches, stitched seams and set bones fall away from it one by one. Dark brown with pale scars of old seams. The wood is old, dry and fire-black at the grain, scarred all over with the seams of grafts that have fallen out, and the hollow knot looks down without any eyes at all.
palette: black-brown wood, rock black, pale seams
formal: It stands on a lonely black rock platform with sheer cliffs all round and no road up, carved steps crumbling behind it, the grafts dropping from its body.
art: From the cliff foot looking up: the single knot, a dim brown light from above, falling twigs blurred in front.

name: 死水威沛
who: Wepei, a seated figure made entirely of one block of still muddy water, the surface perfectly flat without a single ripple, the face a smooth plane of water that reflects nothing. Murky yellow-green, unmoving, with no limbs defined beyond the seated outline. Nothing flows, nothing drips and nothing reflects; only the faint murky colour tells it from glass.
palette: murky yellow-green, black stone
formal: It sits on a black stone platform above a spring that wells up muddy water, the tide never reaching the platform, its water body perfectly still.
art: From the spring side looking up: the flat water face, a dull yellow-green light from the left, murky droplets blurred in front.

name: 积秽布耶尔
who: Buyer, a hunched squatting shape built from layers of unrotting remains, with the bones and iron frames of broken clockwork soldiers and wolves set into it. No face. Dead leaves brown, bone white and rust red, piled up layer on layer. It is heavy, slumped and quiet, and everything returned to it stays.
palette: rotted leaf brown, bone white, rust red
formal: It squats on a black stone platform floating in a low marsh, beneath it layer upon layer of leaves, bones and broken weapons that never decay.
art: From the marsh surface looking up: the heaped hunched silhouette, a dull brown light from the left, rust flecks blurred in front.

name: 落空之冠格莫瑞
who: Gemori, a huge broad seated humanoid under a black crown that will not sit steady and keeps tipping, the face dark beneath it. A broken bell and a coin that always lands the wrong side up lie at its feet. A fitted doublet split down the middle in black and white.
palette: black, white, dull gold
formal: He sits on a flat-topped black mountain like a laid table, the crown hovering unsteadily above his head, a gravel shore of stones black on one face and white on the other spread below.
art: From the gravel below: the unsteady crown and the dark face, a cold light from the right, stones blurred in front.

name: 收线之剪欧洛巴斯
who: Oloras, a tall figure about three metres high holding a huge pair of shears across the lap, a ring of black stones carved with writing floating around it, the face hidden in shadow. A fitted iron-grey long coat with buttons down the front and fitted sleeves. It never speaks falsely, and it already knows how every battle will end.
palette: iron grey, black stone
formal: He sits on a plateau throne ringed by standing black stones carved with the results of battles not yet fought, the shears closed in his lap.
art: From among the stones: the shears and the hidden face, a cold iron light from the left, floating stones blurred in front.

name: 绊脚之石华利弗
who: Hualifu, a staircase of blue-grey stones laid in uneven offsets, each step a little higher or a little lower than the last so that not one tread is level. It is a built thing and not a person: no limbs, no face, only a long stack of offset steps climbing in the frame like a tall single figure. Weathered, worn smooth in the middle of each step by generations of children's feet, cold and patient.
palette: blue-grey stone, black mountain, pale sky
formal: The staircase rises to the flat top of a sheer-sided black mountain and ends at a plain stone seat, the steps stacked unevenly one upon another, small camp children far below learning to walk on the first treads.
art: From the first step looking steeply up the stairs: the offset treads climbing to a pale sky, a cool grey light from the left, loose pebbles blurred in front.

name: 迷失的归路安洛先
who: Anloxian, a tall man of about three metres wrapped in a layer of haze, so that he can always be seen and never reached; his outline is soft and the face cannot be made out. In the open palm of one hand lies a key that cannot be seen, only the empty shape of where it would lie. A fitted pale grey long coat with buttoned front and fitted sleeves, plain and clean. Quiet, courteous, impossible to find.
palette: haze grey, pale silver, faint blue
formal: He sits upright on a plain stone seat on the top of a black mountain, a bank of grey haze lying round the seat, the open empty palm held forward toward the viewer, the coat's pale grey fading into the haze at the edges.
art: From the haze at the foot of the seat looking up: the soft outline and the empty palm, a diffuse grey light with no clear source, drifting fog blurred in front.

name: 差一刻的路口西迪
who: Sidi, a tall man of about three metres who is always seen from behind; the face is never shown, only the back of a hooded head and broad shoulders turned away. In one hand he holds a lamp that has not been lit. A fitted dusk-purple long coat with a hood, buttoned down the back, fitted sleeves, plain boots. He seems always about to turn around and never does.
palette: dusk purple, ash grey, a point of unlit brass
formal: He sits on a plain stone seat at the top of a flat mountain with his back to the viewer and his head turned slightly away, the unlit lamp set on the arm of the seat, a ring road winding the slope below where two travellers pass on opposite sides.
art: From behind and below: the turned back and the unlit lamp, a dusk violet light from the left edge, road dust blurred in front.

name: 还赃安杜马利乌士
who: Andumalius, a tall man of about three metres with one left arm unnaturally long and always held outstretched, with taken things hung along it: chains, rings, bundles, a child's shoe. The face is hidden in the shadow of a hood. A fitted long coat of black stone grey with old bronze buttons, fitted sleeves, the right arm ordinary. Patient, exact, never giving anything back.
palette: black stone, old bronze, dull rust
formal: He sits upright in a seat of black stone at the end of a long hall of shelves holding objects reclaimed over thousands of years and never returned, the long left arm laid out across the aisle with the hung objects swinging a little.
art: From the aisle below looking up the length of the arm: the arm and the hooded shadow, a dim bronze light from the left, shelf-ends blurred in front.

name: 暗记之签比列斯
who: Biles, a tall man of about three metres with one hand always inside a stone lot-drum that stands taller than a man, the face hidden under a hood. A fitted grey long coat with buttons and fitted sleeves, one sleeve rolled to the elbow for the drum. Slips of wood fall from the drum now and again, and nobody can tell which are marked.
palette: stone grey, dry wood, black
formal: He sits on a plain stone seat on a raised plateau with the great lot-drum at his side, his right arm in the drum to the shoulder, a few lot-slips on the stone beside him.
art: From below the drum looking up: the arm in the drum and the hooded face, a flat grey light, falling slips blurred in front.

name: 不雨的云欧里亚斯
who: Orias, a vast leaden cloud with a human shape hidden inside it: a faint seated figure of denser cloud, the face invisible. It spreads over a whole plain. No rain ever falls from it and the ground below is cracked into plates that a hand could be pushed into. Lead grey above, dry earth yellow below.
palette: lead grey, dry earth yellow, dull ochre
formal: The cloud sits over a raised plateau throne and presses down on it, the seated shape of denser cloud darker at its centre, the ground below cracked into plates, not a drop falling.
art: From the cracked ground looking up at the heavy cloud: the underside lit by a dull yellow-grey light, dust blurred in front.

name: 失先埃力格
who: Erig, a tall man of about three metres in a bone-white long coat with fitted sleeves and buttons down the front, holding a long spear upright at his side, the face hidden under a hood. The spear is bone-pale from tip to butt. A bell above the hall rings a half beat faster than a heart, and he always moves a half beat after.
palette: bone white, black, bell bronze
formal: He sits upright on a plain bone-white seat in a black stone hall with a bell hung high above, the spear held upright beside the seat, ranks of white-clad followers kneeling in the shadows below.
art: From the floor of the hall looking up: the spear and the hooded face, a pale bone light from the left, dust blurred in front.

name: 孤身的凯旋瓦布拉
who: Vabra, a tall man of about three metres standing alone, wrapped in a long cloak without a single patch or tear, a hood drawn forward so that only one eye shows, steady and unblinking. A fitted coat beneath the cloak with buttons down the front. The colour of burnt-bright metal, as if the only survivor of a charge had come home.
palette: furnace orange, cloak grey, black
formal: He stands alone on the top of a sheer-sided black mountain so narrow that only one person can stand there, the ranks of camps spreading to the horizon beneath him and nothing standing behind him.
art: From the camp below looking up: the single eye in the hood, a furnace orange light from the left, smoke blurred in front.

name: 不容死的痛古辛
who: Gushin, a tall man of about three metres, thin, covered in open sores that glow a faint dark green and never close, the face hidden under a hood. He walks behind battles, not in them. A plain fitted dark long coat with the sleeves torn open at the sores, buttoned at the front, and bandage strips hanging from the cuffs. Everyone near him is hurt and no one dies.
palette: dark green, black stone, bandage grey
formal: He sits on a low plain seat in a squat black stone hall on a hill, a small dark green flame burning on the roof ridge behind him, the sores glowing through the torn coat, the hooded face turned down.
art: From the floor of the hall looking up: the sores and the hidden face, a dark green light from the left, strips of bandage blurred in front.

name: 瘟街的医者马巴斯
who: Mabas, a tall man of about three metres dressed like a physician, in a long coat buttoned to the neck with the sleeves rolled up to the elbow, steam rising from the body, a bowl of warm spring water held in both hands. The face is hidden under a plain cloth hood. He looks kind and attentive, a good doctor, and where he cures one, ten fall ill down the street.
palette: sickly yellow, steam white, clean linen
formal: He sits on a plain stone seat beside a warm spring in a steaming hollow, holding the bowl out toward the viewer, steam rising from the water and from his shoulders.
art: From the spring's edge looking up: the bowl, the steam and the hooded face, a warm pale light from the right, steam blurred in front.

name: 无啼萨米吉那
who: Samigina, a tall woman of about two and a half metres wrapped in a black hooded cloak that falls straight to the ground, the face hidden in the hood. A fitted black gown with a high collar and buttons beneath. Around her stand small cradles of carved stone, all empty. The only sound near her is of children speaking, one line after another, from no mouth.
palette: black, stone grey, a faint pale glow
formal: She sits upright on a plain black stone seat on a platform at the bottom of a dry river gorge, a circle of empty carved stone cradles set before the platform, the hooded face level and still.
art: From among the cradles looking up: the hooded figure with a faint pale light from the left, the nearest cradles blurred in front.

name: 裂创格剌希亚拉波斯
who: Glasyalabolas, a huge broad man of red sandstone, about three metres, whose body is cut with open fissures that weep red like a wound that cannot be bound. The face is a worn blank of stone under a heavy brow. Loose strips of bandage trail from the cracks. A rough sleeveless surcoat of stone-coloured cloth, the arms bare and cracked.
palette: red sandstone, weeping red, bandage pale
formal: He sits heavily on a seat cut into the red sandstone cliff of a high plateau, red seeping down the cliff face below him, a dark red fire burning on the plateau top beside the seat.
art: From the foot of the cliff looking up: the weeping fissures and the blank face, a dull red light from the fire, torn bandage strips blurred in front.

name: 无眠之呓安德雷斐斯
who: Andrefis, a tall man of about three metres, hardly more than an outline in white mist, the face hidden by it, as if still half in a dream. A fitted long coat of mist grey with buttons down the front, fitted sleeves. Somewhere in the fog someone talks in their sleep. He can neither sleep nor wake.
palette: mist white, lake black, pale grey
formal: He sits upright on a black stone in the middle of a black lake in a misty valley, the still water around the stone mirroring the viewer's own fear, the mist rising round his shoulders.
art: From the lake shore looking across and up: the misted figure, a white-grey light from behind, drifting mist blurred in front.

name: 错位之骨弗劳洛斯
who: Flauros, a skeleton giant whose every long bone is folded the wrong way, standing and sitting crooked, the skull tilted on a bent neck with no features, the finger bones turned backward. Taller than any bell-tower of the surrounding camp. Bone white and nothing else, with a faint grey shadow in the hollows.
palette: bone white, pit dark, ash grey
formal: It sits at the bottom of the deepest pit of the bone camp, its crooked bent frame propped on the pit floor, ring after ring of bell-towers dug into the ground round the pit rim, all lower than its head.
art: From the pit rim looking up at the bent frame: the tilted skull and reversed joints, a pale bone light from the left, dust blurred in front.

name: 黑暗里的冷手沙克斯
who: Shax, a huge cold dead-white hand in the black, the fingers long and open, the body behind it unseen and unseeable, no face, no features. It is the only visible thing in the picture. The skin of the hand is a dead white with no warmth in it, and the nails are blunt.
palette: black, dead white
formal: The hand rests open on the arm of a seat in a windowless black hall, palm up, the rest of the seat swallowed in darkness, the fire on the roof visible only to someone with closed eyes.
art: From the dark below the hand: the palm in a faint white light, nothing else visible, black grain blurred in front.

name: 解药里的毒巴钦
who: Bachin, a tall man of about three metres dressed like an apothecary, in a long coat with buttons to the neck, an apron with pockets full of vials, the face hidden under a deep hood. He holds a medicine bowl in one hand. Rows of jars sealed with yellow wax stand round him. The cure in the bowl is the second poison.
palette: swamp green, wax yellow, dull glass
formal: He sits on a plain black stone in the middle of a platform in a swamp, rows of wax-sealed jars stacked on every side, the bowl held out toward the viewer.
art: From among the jars looking up: the apothecary figure with the bowl, a sickly green light from the left, wax drips blurred in front.

name: 回魂的号角姆尔姆尔
who: Mulmul, a tall man of about three metres with a huge horn hung on the chest, the face hidden under a pale hood. A fitted long coat of birch white with buttons down the front and fitted sleeves, bone slips tied to the cuffs. White fire burns around the cairn on which he sits. Those who died are called back, again and again.
palette: birch white, bone white, white flame
formal: He sits upright on the top of a cairn of stones in a birch wood, the cairn packed with name-carved bone slips, white fire burning in a ring at his feet.
art: From the foot of the cairn looking up: the horn and the hooded face, a white fire light from below, bone slips blurred in front.

name: 嫁祸之身罗诺比
who: Ronobi, a tall man of about three metres with unblemished white skin without a mark on it, the face hidden under a clean white hood. A fitted white long coat, spotless, buttoned to the neck. The people standing beside him are bruised and bleeding in his place, with purple on their arms and faces.
palette: clean white, bruise purple, black rock
formal: He sits upright on a clean stone seat at the summit of a sheer-sided black mountain whose cave-rooms below are packed with bruised people standing as close as they can to him.
art: From below looking up past the bruised hands: the clean white figure, a pale light from the left, a bruised hand blurred in front.

name: 背誓者乌瓦尔
who: Uwal, a tall man of about three metres, entirely ink-black from hood to boots, the face hidden. A fitted black long coat with buttons down the front and fitted sleeves, as if wet ink had been left to dry. On one hand a stone ring. Beside the seat stands a stone stele into which oaths are cut, one line at a time, each cracking.
palette: ink black, stone grey, cold white cracks
formal: He sits upright on a plain black stone seat on a black stone plateau, the cracked oath stele beside him, lines carved and split one under another, the stone ring on his hand resting on the arm of the seat.
art: From below looking up past the stele: the black figure, a cold grey light from the left, stone chips blurred in front.

name: 不认输的乱刃萨布诺克
who: Sabnock, a mass of many men pressed together into one knot with dozens of blades drawn at once, no single man to be told from the others, mud and old blood on every sleeve, every blade turned a different way. Nothing in the knot heals. Mud brown and steel grey. The knot shifts as one thing and is never still, ugly and noisy and tireless.
palette: mud brown, steel grey, old blood
formal: It stands as a single standing knot of men and blades on a low stone platform in the middle of a trampled bare plain.
art: From the mud looking up at the knot of blades: a dull muddy light from the left, flying mud blurred in front.

name: 弃盾者哈法斯
who: Hafas, a tall figure of about three metres that is more a shadow than a man, standing above the black towers, the face hidden, both arms empty and shieldless. A fitted dark coat. Every time the towers ring, a man in the front rank drops his shield. Black towers crowd round its feet, each one packed with taken weapons.
palette: tower black, steel glint, shadow grey
formal: He stands on the top of the highest black tower on a plateau crowded with black stone towers, empty arms hanging, the towers below packed with weapons.
art: From below the towers looking up: the shadow figure against a hard sky, a cold light from the left with a steel glint on the tower edges, dust blurred in front.

name: 绝后者亚蒙
who: Amon, a giant in massive armour of black iron and old bone, broad and heavy, with a heavy plate hood over the head, only a smooth dark shadow beneath it and no face. A long old wound in the chest from which white light shines. Seen from behind there is no back, only sand. The thick plates are fitted, scarred and old.
palette: black iron, old bone, one white glow
formal: He sits upright on a plain seat on the top of a lonely black mountain with only a road leading up, the white light of the chest wound shining forward, the road behind him vanishing piece by piece into sand.
art: From the road looking up at the hooded shadow: the white chest light the only light, a white light from the chest, grit blurred in front.

name: 错号与乱鼓普尔森
who: Pursoon, a tall broad man of about three metres hung all over with brass horns and with a huge drum strapped on the chest, the face hidden under a horned hood. A fitted jerkin of dark leather underneath. When he arrives the horns have already sounded, and both sides take it for a charge.
palette: brass bronze, black stone, dull red leather
formal: He sits heavily on a black stone platform on which hundreds of horns hang from poles, the wind making them all sound at once, the drum on his chest facing the viewer.
art: From below looking up past the hanging horns: the horned hood and the drum, a bronze light from the left, wind-blown dust blurred in front.

name: 城破之后的鸦莱乌姆
who: Raum, a black crow larger than a tower, standing with its wings folded into a human outline, the head a crow's head with a long heavy beak, feathers like black iron flakes, the eyes dull. Black wings, grey ash, the red of embers in the breast. It eats what is left when the city has fallen.
palette: black wing, ash grey, ember red
formal: It perches on a seat of burnt wooden gate planks at the top of an ash slope on a plateau, ash banked on the slope and hot embers glowing beneath, folded wings hanging like a cloak.
art: From the ash slope looking up: the crow head against the smoke, a dull red ember light from below, drifting ash blurred in front.

name: 无鞘的刀安托士
who: Antosh, a sword without a scabbard, taller than a tower, standing upright with the point on the ground. A man-shaped figure stands behind it, hardly visible, and has no face. The blade is bare and long, cold white from edge to edge, with no fuller and no ornament. The fire in the hall is never fed and never goes out.
palette: blade white, black stone, fire orange
formal: The great blade stands upright in the middle of a black stone hall before a fire that nobody tends and nothing puts out, the figure standing behind the hilt.
art: From the hall floor looking up the blade's flat: the blade edge catching the fire, a cold white light from the fire at lower right, sparks blurred in front.

name: 终身之创桀派
who: Jepai, a tall man of about three metres, bare-armed and covered in old unhealed scars that are still wet, the face hidden under a hood. He wears a fitted plain coat with the sleeves rolled up. The first wound a man gets stays with him all his life. The scars are old, deep and open-edged, and each is a different age.
palette: scar red, stone grey
formal: He sits on a plain stone seat on a stone platform covered with cracks like old scars that have never knit, his arms laid on the seat arms with the scars facing out.
art: From below looking up: the scars on the arms, a dull red light from the left, dust blurred in front.

name: 门外不进的影波提斯
who: Potis, a tall man of about three metres like an old soldier standing outside a door and never going in, in a worn long coat with fitted sleeves and buttons, an old spear shaft broken short in one hand, the face hidden by the dusk behind the door. Nothing can talk him out of any trouble but the thing that would take him home.
palette: dusk grey, worn leather brown, door black
formal: He stands before a closed door at the end of a gravel path at the far west of the world, the door shut and his shadow lying against it, the broken spear shaft held at his side.
art: From the path below looking up: the old soldier's shape against a shut door, a dusk grey light from the left, dust blurred in front.
